rendering_style.text: 画面使用干净的平面色块，优先保证字形边缘清楚。

color_palette.text: 广阔的低饱和冷灰蓝展墙构成海报基底，少量琥珀暖色只用于标题和近旁的一小处投光。

edge_control.text: 主标题字面边缘清楚连续，纸页和展墙的轮廓较弱并断续融入相邻色面。

detail_density.text: 细节与图文对比集中于标题区，外围保留疏略纸页面形和大面积低密度色块。

subject.text: 表现阅读活动的主标题与抽象纸页轮廓组成的海报。

setting.text: 用展墙般的平面大冷色块建立安静环境。

visual_path.text: 由暗色纸页面形引导视线读到主标题，让唯一暖点、清晰边缘和主要细节在文字区域会合。

protected_items.text: 日期紧随主标题置于下方并降低字号，保持从上到下的阅读顺序。

rendering_style.text: Use clean flat color areas and prioritize crisp glyph edges.

color_palette.text: Use a broad, low-saturation cool blue-gray exhibition wall as the poster base; restrict the small amber accent to the title and a small nearby light patch.

edge_control.text: Keep the title glyph edges clear and continuous; weaken and break the page and wall contours into the neighboring masses.

detail_density.text: Concentrate detail and text contrast in the title area; retain sparse page silhouettes and broad, low-density masses around it.

subject.text: Create a reading-event poster featuring the main title and abstract page silhouettes.

setting.text: Establish a quiet setting with broad cool color masses like a flat exhibition wall.

visual_path.text: Guide the eye from the dark page silhouettes to the main title, where the only warm accent, clearest edges, and primary detail converge.

protected_items.text: Set the date immediately below the main title at a smaller size, preserving a top-to-bottom reading order.
